_comment: MS1.1 required-component inventory (plan rev 6, macOS plan:396-401). The universal
macOS app bundles native Mach-O code beyond the browser; EVERY bundled Mach-O must be
fat (x86_64 + arm64), and these required roles must all be present. The census
(tests/e2e/mac_universal_test.py) scans the bundle for every Mach-O and requires each
fat, so an UNLISTED single-arch binary cannot sneak through, AND requires each role
below to be present, so a green cannot ship only zigBrowser fat and drop the runtime.
'match' is the file basename a bundled Mach-O for that role must have. Non-executable
resources are listed under 'resources' and must be present; their byte-compatibility
across the two per-arch trees is verified by packaging/macos/build-dmg.sh before lipo
(the MS1 green), which this per-host census cannot do with a single arch tree.
